law: This template is DELIBERATELY INVALID under trust/OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN.schema.json. The production verifier reads only trust/OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN.json; while that file is absent or carries status OWNER_KEY_NOT_YET_PINNED, every production verification fails closed with OWNER_KEY_NOT_PINNED. To pin: the owner generates an Ed25519 keypair OFFLINE (the private key never enters this repository or any machine Claude operates), copies this template to trust/OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY_PIN.json, fills key_id (must NOT start with TEST-), owner_ed25519_public_key_hex, and pinned_by, deletes the TEMPLATE and status fields, and commits that pin in an owner-controlled commit.
